criterion.question: Can high-wear OTS components be removed and replaced without destroying the frame or custom panels?

reviews.rationale: The cook station has exposed burners and controls that can be accessed without destroying the frame or custom panels.
reviews.acceptance_check: Visual inspection of the cook station's design.
